It does NOT attempt the 1093 deferred rows: R-60 read FWD-5's ACCEPT at the bytes and the outcome IS THE LIST -- 'THIS IS THE LIST CLEAN-UP PROJECTS START FROM' -- so resolution is the clean-up projects' work, and rounds 5 and 6 ground against a bar FWD-5 never set.

the_51_two_remedy_rows._instrument: re-identified INDEPENDENTLY of the record's own CADENCE_PLUS_SYSTEM label, by requiring BOTH '{system}' and '{cadence}' to appear in the row's own text. Agreement with the declared count is the corroboration; the label is not the test.
the_51_two_remedy_rows.why_they_matter: NEITHER REMEDY ALONE CLEARS A ROW: the {system} half is inside a cell's grant (a resources.json row), the {cadence} half is not. A row needing two remedies filed under a one-remedy label is INVISIBLE TO BOTH -- Rule 24 INTENT COHERENCE failing inside the campaign built to enumerate.

the_15_key_templates._instrument: the carded rows carrying any of the five UNSANCTIONED tokens measured by round 6
the_15_key_templates.disposition: R-62 (c) ADOPTED: leave them CARDED under a TRUE reason. The present card says the TOKEN IS NOT A SYSTEM; the truth is THE ROW IS NOT A NAME. A key format template is a producer's runtime substitution field, so 'resolve from a declared source' never applied -- there was no source because there was no substitution question.
the_15_key_templates.NOT_DONE_HERE_AND_WHY: R-62 REFUSED removing S3Key from the name grade: it would remove EVERY S3 key in the estate to fix 15 templates, and Rule 30 makes S3 addresses the core naming surface. A mechanism distinguishing a TEMPLATE from a KEY is ROUND 8 material -- a schema change needs Rule 24's four-postulate record and a token census, never a rider.

the_41_inferred_owner_claims.what_confirmation_must_reach: an OWNING DIRECTIVE, not a sibling's inheritance. Every one of the 41 carries a two-leg owner_basis: LEG A a declared source (a manifest or tf_type_map attribute), LEG B the system carried by its own IAM role -- and leg B inherits from a sibling whose OWN claim is inferred, which is why the whole row reads inferred.

the_exclusion_switch_HAZARD._about: NOT this round's work. Pinned because both cells read this table and a reader who trusts its NAME will be wrong, as a CTO ruling already was.
the_exclusion_switch_HAZARD.the_real_switch: lib/opal_naming.py:493 unions the WHOLE table into graded_types; :1012 takes a type out only if str(why).startswith('NOT GRADED'). So the switch is whether a HUMAN-WRITTEN PROSE REASON begins with two particular words.
the_exclusion_switch_HAZARD.why_it_is_a_hazard: REWORDING A REASON SILENTLY CHANGES GRADING BEHAVIOUR. Turning 'NOT GRADED: AWS-issued identifier' into 'AWS-issued identifier, not graded' -- an improvement in ordinary prose -- puts that type BACK INTO THE GRADE and nothing announces it. 8 types sit on that edge.
the_exclusion_switch_HAZARD.ruled: R-62 @2c3d7b0cb2; the mechanism fix belongs with round 8's (b).
